device.description: 18-bit single-channel voltage-output DAC with 24-bit SPI interface, LDAC, hardware reset to zero or mid scale and SDO read-back / daisy chain
device.note: dac9881.pdf (SBAS438C) p.3-4 (pin functions), p.5 (recommended operating conditions: IOVDD 1.7 V to AVDD, AVDD 2.7-5.5 V), p.10-11 (timing requirements), p.12-14 (timing diagrams), p.30-31 (input data format, hardware/power-on reset, Table 3 reset values, power down, double-buffered interface, LDAC), p.32 (serial interface, Table 4 data word, stand-alone and daisy-chain modes)

registers.name: IN
registers.note: input register D17-D0 (p.32 Table 4); power-on/RST value 00000h with RSTSEL = DGND (p.31 Table 3)

registers.name: XHI
registers.note: internal: the don't-care bits B23-B18 of the last valid 24-bit word, read back with the input register in stand-alone mode (p.32: the 24-bit input register is shifted out on SDO)

registers.name: DACL
registers.note: DAC latch; loaded from the input register while LDAC is low (p.31)

commands.name: DATA WORD
commands.note: SDI clocked in on SCLK rising; the last 24 bits before CS rising are transferred to the input register at CS rising; a frame of fewer than 24 bits is invalid and ignored (p.32)

protocol.note: stand-alone mode (SDOSEL = IOVDD): SDO shifts out the existing 24-bit input register while the new word shifts in, then zeros (p.32, Figure 2)

pages: p.3-4 (pins), p.5 (recommended operating conditions), p.10-11 (timing requirements: tValid t10 15 ns, tOut t11 20 ns, tFloat t13 8 ns at the 2.7-V row), p.12-14 (timing diagrams: SDI sampled on SCLK rising, SDO valid at CS falling and changed on SCLK falling = mode 0), p.30-31 (reset, power down, LDAC), p.32 (serial interface, data word, SDO modes)
notModeled: analog output (VOUT, RFB), reference force/sense inputs (VREFH-F/S, VREFL-F/S), output buffer gain strap GAIN (analog only)

USB/BTC input data format strap (straight binary / twos complement): affects only the analog output; the stored code is the written word. The two's-complement restriction on LDAC during hardware reset is not checked

daisy-chain mode (SDOSEL = DGND): SDO outputs the shift register delayed by 24 clocks (the previous word, then the new SDI bits). The model shifts out the stored 24-bit word in both modes and zeros after it (stand-alone behavior); the echo of the new bits is not modeled
PDN hardware power-down: VOUT is pulled to AGND (analog only); registers and SPI stay active (p.31), so it is not mapped to pins.powerdown, which would ignore the bus
stand-alone read-back of a frame with fewer than 24 SCLKs (the datasheet says the SDO data must be ignored)
the input shift register is not reset by power-on or RST (p.31); the model starts it empty
timing degrades for IOVDD 1.7-2.7 V (no figures given); times use the 2.7 <= AVDD < 3.6 V rows
variants: DAC9881S and DAC9881SB are accuracy grades of the same device (same pinout and interface)
